svg.aria-label: A single spec file produced by the skill: the task title, its type and source timestamps, a user story, the quoted remark it came from, and a wireframe of the screen it refers to with the new row highlighted.
svg.text: Add a Past notes list pulled from the Hub
As a user, I want to reach my past meeting notes from the
menu-bar dropdown, so that I can jump back to a recent
meeting’s notes without hunting for the URL.
“Past notes. I also would like to introduce a new
past notes. We already have the account and we
can pull it from the hub.”
The menu-bar dropdown, opened from the tray icon:
